ld.description: Mexican restaurant and rooftop bar at 1 Penn Plaza in Midtown Manhattan, next to Madison Square Garden and Penn Station.

mainEntity.name: Where is Avenida, the Mexican Restaurant located?

acceptedAnswer.text: Avenida is located at 1 Penn Plaza in Midtown Manhattan, directly near Madison Square Garden (MSG) and Penn Station. Our convenient location makes us a great spot for lunch, dinner, drinks, and pre-event dining before concerts, Knicks games, Rangers games, and events at MSG.

mainEntity.name: What kind of food does Avenida serve?

acceptedAnswer.text: Avenida serves fresh Mexican food, including tacos, burritos, quesadillas, nachos, bowls, guacamole, street corn, and more. We also offer handcrafted margaritas, cocktails, and brunch specials in the heart of Midtown Manhattan.

Yes. Avenida offers online ordering for pickup and takeout. Guests can easily order tacos, burritos, bowls, and drinks online for a fast and convenient Midtown Manhattan dining experience. Ordering takeout ahead is perfect for commuters, office lunches, and quick meals before catching a train or attending an event at Madison Square Garden.

mainEntity.name: Does Avenida provide Mexican catering in NYC?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Avenida offers Mexican catering for offices, corporate events, parties, meetings, and private gatherings in New York City. Our catering menu includes tacos, burrito platters, chips and guacamole, salads, and more.

Yes. Avenida offers a popular bottomless brunch near Penn Station featuring Mexican brunch favorites, tacos, cocktails, and unlimited drinks on selected handcrafted cocktails (90 mins) during brunch hours.
